# VideoLAN libvlc-all 3.6.5

Copyright VideoLAN and the VLC contributors. The [published POM](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/videolan/android/libvlc-all/3.6.5/libvlc-all-3.6.5.pom) identifies the library as LGPL 2.1. Individual files retain their upstream notices.

- Unmodified [AAR](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/videolan/android/libvlc-all/3.6.5/libvlc-all-3.6.5.aar) in `app/libs/libvlc-all-3.6.5.aar`. SHA-256 `6a15a1f7acd0738a31acce0c7e5eb6f5f340b62e6b64d8f83df547da56a44b47`.
- The upstream [Java sources JAR](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/videolan/android/libvlc-all/3.6.5/libvlc-all-3.6.5-sources.jar) is included alongside this notice.
- JNI sources and native build scripts are maintained in [VideoLAN libvlcjni](https://code.videolan.org/videolan/libvlcjni). The ARMv7 library reports VLC `3.0.22-rc1-37-gfe81489755` in its build metadata. See [VLC revision fe81489755](https://code.videolan.org/videolan/vlc/-/commit/fe81489755) for the native engine source.
- The included [GNU LGPL 2.1 text](LICENSE.libvlc) describes the rights to copy, modify and relink the library. To rebuild the application with a compatible modified library, replace the AAR and use the build command in the top-level README.
